title: Simple Past Passive
description: Learn to form past passive with was/were + past participle

explain.ta: Simple past passive-ஐ உருவாக்க was/were + past participle பயன்படுத்துகிறோம். Active: 'They built the house in 1990' → Passive: 'The house was built in 1990'. Past passive-ஐ நாம் கடந்த காலத்தில் நடந்த செயல்களை விவரிக்க பயன்படுத்துகிறோம், குறிப்பாக வரலாறு, செய்திகள், மற்றும் அறிக்கைகளில். இது formal மற்றும் objective tone-ஐ உருவாக்க உதவுகிறது.
explain.en: To form simple past passive: use was/were + past participle. Active: 'They built the house in 1990' → Passive: 'The house was built in 1990'. We use past passive to describe completed actions in the past, especially in history, news reports, and formal descriptions. It helps create a formal and objective tone by focusing on what happened rather than who did it.

examples: The door was opened at 8 AM.
The doors were opened at 8 AM.

examples.en: The movie was directed by a famous director.
The letter was sent last week.
The meeting was cancelled due to rain.
The documents were signed by both parties.
The students were taught by an experienced teacher.

listeningQuestions.audioText: The car was repaired last month.
options: The car is repaired last month.
The car was repaired last month.
The car were repaired last month.

listeningQuestions.audioText: The windows were cleaned this morning.
options: The windows was cleaned this morning.
The windows are cleaned this morning.
The windows were cleaned this morning.

listeningQuestions.audioText: The report was submitted on time.
options: The report was submitted on time.
The report were submitted on time.
The report is submitted on time.

speakSentences.en: The photos were taken last summer.
The decision was made by the committee.

practiceQuestions.promptEn: Active: They opened the store in 2010. Passive: The store ___ in 2010.
practiceQuestions.promptTa: Active: அவர்கள் கடையை 2010-ல் திறந்தார்கள். Passive: கடை 2010-ல் ___.

practiceQuestions.promptEn: Active: She wrote the email. Passive: The email ___ by her.
practiceQuestions.promptTa: Active: அவள் மின்னஞ்சல் எழுதினாள். Passive: மின்னஞ்சல் அவளால் ___.

practiceQuestions.promptEn: Active: They invited many guests. Passive: Many guests ___.
practiceQuestions.promptTa: Active: அவர்கள் பல விருந்தினர்களை அழைத்தார்கள். Passive: பல விருந்தினர்கள் ___.

practiceQuestions.promptEn: Active: He fixed the computer. Passive: The computer ___ by him.
practiceQuestions.promptTa: Active: அவர் கணினியை சரி செய்தார். Passive: கணினி அவரால் ___.

practiceQuestions.promptEn: Active: They painted the walls. Passive: The walls ___.
practiceQuestions.promptTa: Active: அவர்கள் சுவர்களை வர்ணம் பூசினார்கள். Passive: சுவர்கள் ___.

masteryQuestions.promptEn: The prizes ___ to the winners yesterday.
The song ___ by a famous singer.
The books ___ in the library last week.
